comparison.objective: Relieve, disconnect, and cap a hydraulic quick coupler, versus fracture and recover insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Pressure-relief sequencing, sleeve/coupler disengagement, and capping rather than bimanual hammering and tiny-fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Coupler safely relieved, disconnected, and capped; quantitative pressure/leak criteria are absent. Candidate requires four fractures, containment, and no component damage.
comparison.reason: Both demand force control, but the central mechanisms and outcomes—coupler release versus notch fracture—are materially different.
